market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver futures currently trade around $30; a move to $120 would require a 4x increase to more than double the all-time high, an outcome with vanishingly small probability over ~1.5 years. The market-implied 6.7% chance severely overstates this likelihood.
evidence_points: All-time high for silver is ~$50, reached in 1980 and 2011, so $120 represents an unprecedented level.
Industrial demand and substitution effects cap extreme price spikes absent a monetary collapse.
No plausible catalyst—monetary, economic, or geopolitical—justifies a 4x rally in silver within 1.5 years.
sources_consulted: CME silver settlement data and price history
Silver supply/demand reports from USGS and industry
